relations.rationale: Leo's driving has no bearing on Noor's robot color.
Leo's driving status is unrelated to Kira's and Ivo's design part counts.
Leo's driving status has no connection to trial performance of Kira's and Ivo's designs.
Being the oldest participant could plausibly explain why Leo took on a mentoring role helping newer members, slightly supporting it.
Leo's age has no bearing on Noor's robot color.
Leo's age is unrelated to the number of parts in Kira's or Ivo's designs.
Leo's age has no connection to how Kira's and Ivo's designs performed.
Leo helping others solder wires has nothing to do with Noor's robot's paint color.
Leo's soldering assistance is unrelated to the part counts of Kira's and Ivo's designs.
Leo's mentoring activity has no bearing on the trial outcomes of Kira's and Ivo's designs.
Noor's robot color is unrelated to the part counts of Kira's and Ivo's designs.
Noor's robot color has no bearing on how Kira's and Ivo's designs performed in trials.

Kira's design using fewer parts than Ivo's does not imply anything about whether they performed equally well, so it's essentially unrelated though could suggest efficiency without necessarily affecting equal performance claim.
